objective: Preserve weak normal and metallic/smoothness physical-data signals for the generic PBR library until native-4K frontal, oblique, grazing and temporal evidence can verify them.

sharedRules.wetnessRule: Dry midsummer benchmark baseline. Wetness may only be introduced by a modeled causal water source and may not be painted into a highlight.
sharedRules.angularResponse: Dielectric microfacet response with Fresnel increase toward grazing angles; highlight direction must come from scene lighting, never from texture paint.
sharedRules.geometryVsMaterialDetail: Silhouette, construction thickness, joints, curb edges, trunks, branches and leaf cards stay geometric. Texture normals/masks carry only surface-scale aggregate, pores, grains, veins, fibres and similarly fine relief.
sharedRules.uvAging: Age only through bounded loss of saturation/contrast and cause-based exposure effects; no light-direction-dependent aging is baked into albedo, normal or smoothness.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Dry maintained grass over soil; broad clumps and ground exposure are geometric/contextual while blade-scale relief is material detail.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Midsummer sun permits restrained dry/bare flecks from daily wear; no unexplained glossy wet response.
profiles.angularResponse: Broad dielectric grass/soil response; grazing sparkle must be controlled by mip/aniso behavior rather than baked brightness.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Compacted mineral soil with small pebble-scale relief; depressions/grade changes remain geometry.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Dry exposed earth; local darkening requires modeled moisture or occlusion context.
profiles.angularResponse: Very broad low-intensity dielectric lobe with no metallic glint.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Cast exterior concrete; slab/fascia thickness, seams and construction interfaces are geometry, while pores and fine aggregate remain texture relief.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Neutral aggregate/pitting baseline. Streaks or deposits require a sill, drain, ground edge or metal source.
profiles.angularResponse: Rough mineral dielectric response; no directional highlight is stored in the maps.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Washed/aggregate-exposed concrete; aggregate-scale variation is material relief while panel thickness and joins remain geometry.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Exposure can vary aggregate contrast modestly; stains remain cause-based and separate from the neutral substrate.
profiles.angularResponse: Broad rough dielectric lobe whose grazing breakup follows aggregate normals.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Mineral paving surface; curb height, slab/module boundaries and major joints are geometry where benchmark-visible, with granular relief in textures.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Dry pedestrian exposure with restrained joint contrast; no unexplained dark wet patches.
profiles.angularResponse: Rough dielectric paving response; highlight orientation follows coherent midsummer sun and sky fill.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Dry broadleaf lamina represented by foliage geometry/cards; veins and minute lamina undulation remain material microdetail.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Midsummer sun variation is bounded; no wet sheen absent a causal source.
profiles.angularResponse: Dielectric leaf response with grazing Fresnel; no painted sun spot or view-dependent highlight in texture data.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Dry broadleaf lamina represented by foliage geometry/cards; veins and minute lamina undulation remain material microdetail.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Midsummer sun variation is bounded; no wet sheen absent a causal source.
profiles.angularResponse: Dielectric leaf response with grazing Fresnel; microdetail must survive mips without temporal sparkle.

profiles.substrateAndAssembly: Tree bark on geometric trunk/branches; trunk taper, branch junctions and silhouette remain geometry while fibre/ridge relief is material detail.
profiles.exposureAndAging: Dry weathered bark may vary fibre value/chroma modestly with exposure; glossy or directional streaks require a modeled cause.
profiles.angularResponse: Very rough dielectric response; ridge normals may break grazing light but may not encode a fixed light direction.

failureInjection: Regress one protected normal or metallic/smoothness map to CompressedHQ and require formal pre-cull failure.
Enable Crunch compression and require failure.
Enable a Standalone platform override and require failure.
Reduce runtime texture size below 1024 and require failure.
Change Trilinear to Bilinear or Point and require failure.
Reduce anisotropy below 8 and require failure.
Enable sRGB on physical data and require failure.
Change a normal away from NormalMap and require failure.
Remove source alpha from a metallic/smoothness map and require failure before evidence rendering.
